project: SF Bay Area Shared Postcard Direct Mail Launch

tasks.title: Choose initial legal setup
tasks.notes: Start as a sole proprietor unless an accountant or attorney recommends an LLC. If using a business name, file an FBN with the county recorder.

tasks.title: File California FBN and local license
tasks.notes: File the fictitious business name with the county recorder, publish for 4 consecutive weeks within 30 days, and check city/county business license requirements.

tasks.title: Research Danville 94526 EDDM routes
tasks.notes: Use eddm.usps.com to identify 2-3 routes totaling 5,000-7,000 households with strong residential density.

tasks.title: Research San Ramon 94582/94583 backup routes
tasks.notes: Save route counts and screenshots for Bishop Ranch and nearby master-planned residential corridors.

tasks.title: Research Pleasanton 94566/94588 alternate routes
tasks.notes: Identify neighborhoods with high homeownership and nearby commercial corridors for future campaigns.

tasks.title: Build 30-40 business prospect list
tasks.notes: Cover 8-10 non-competing categories before outreach: HVAC, pest control, dentistry, pool, landscaping, plumbing, roofing, cleaning, tutoring, med spa.

tasks.title: Lock pricing by community tier
tasks.notes: Use Tier 1 Danville pricing: $700-900 standard ad space and $1,100-1,400 premium placement. Offer founding-partner pricing only for the first campaign.

tasks.title: Prepare first campaign ROI math
tasks.notes: For 5,000 households at $700, most advertisers need 1-3 new customers to break even depending on ticket size and margin.

tasks.title: Draft first email batch
tasks.notes: Personalize the three-email sequence for 10 prospects and keep one exclusive category slot per campaign.

tasks.title: Prepare pitch deck PDF
tasks.notes: Use pitch_deck_bay_area.md as source copy. Export to PDF before sending or bringing to in-person visits.

tasks.title: Send first 10 cold emails
tasks.notes: Prioritize high-ticket local services serving Danville and San Ramon homeowners.

tasks.title: Make phone follow-ups
tasks.notes: Call businesses that opened or replied to the cold email. Lead with category exclusivity and household count.

tasks.title: Collect 50% deposits
tasks.notes: Do not send to design until the agreement is signed and the initial deposit is paid.

tasks.title: Approve proof with all advertisers
tasks.notes: Get written approvals and final balances before printing.

tasks.title: Complete EDDM paperwork and DDU drop-off
tasks.notes: Bundle by USPS route requirements and pay $0.247 per piece at drop-off.

tasks.title: Follow up two weeks after delivery
tasks.notes: Ask each advertiser about calls, appointments, redemptions, and qualitative feedback.

tasks.title: Pitch renewal discount
tasks.notes: Offer 15-20% multi-campaign discount to businesses that renew before the next campaign is opened.
